display.purpose: Count-pod digits, lesson word-list headwords — anything counted, headed, or acted on.

body.purpose: Button labels, gloss text, grammar explanation copy.

label.purpose: Section labels and the page eyebrow header; tracked small caps, always Quicksand.

script.purpose: The wordmark's second word and celebratory feedback lines only; rare by design.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Count-pod counts up from zero on mount; snaps to final value under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: gem-pop
motion.purpose: Gem track dots scale in with a staggered ~45ms delay per gem; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per screen — begin, resume, or review — a flat pill with no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #febcd5; color: #1e1836; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 24px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; transition: filter 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7b0fe; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.9); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions — 'Again' grade, 'Back home', 'Show meaning' — a quiet flat pill that never competes with the primary pink action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #b6acd6; border: 2px solid #4a3f7a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Quicksand', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #d7b0fe; color: #f8f3ff; }

components.name: Cozy Panel
components.description: The bordered rounded card holding a screen's content — count-pod, gem track, word list, or flashcard. Flat fill, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: #2b2450; border: 2px solid #4a3f7a; border-radius: 32px; padding: 32px 24px; } .ds-panel-leaf { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 24px; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: rgba(185,142,230,0.7); }

components.name: Count Pod
components.description: A gradient pill displaying a tabular-numeral count, no shadow; counts up from zero on mount.
components.css: .ds-count-pod { display: flex; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid rgba(185,142,230,0.5); background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #d7b0fe, #febcd5); padding: 8px 6px; } .ds-count-pod span { display: flex; width: 0.8em; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Baloo 2', ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem); font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #1e1836; }

components.name: Gem Track
components.description: A row of small circles tallying a due/pending count, no shadow; filled gems carry a pink-to-lavender gradient and pop in on mount.
components.css: .ds-gem-track { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-gem { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #4a3f7a; background: transparent; } .ds-gem--filled { border-color: #f195b7; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #febcd5, #d7b0fe); }

components.name: Word Row
components.description: A pill row for a lesson vocabulary item — headword, gloss, and a speaker button. Deliberately unornamented, no per-word badge, icon, or shadow.
components.css: .ds-word-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 28px; border: 2px solid #4a3f7a; background: #2b2450; padding: 14px 20px; } .ds-word-text { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; } .ds-word-text strong { font-family: 'Baloo 2', ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; color: #f8f3ff; } .ds-word-text small { font-family: 'Quicksand', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #b6acd6; }

components.name: Treeline
components.description: A fixed background layer tiling along the bottom of the viewport: alternating flat-silhouette pine trees (Lavender/Lavender Dimmed) and blossom trees (Pink/Pink Dimmed), trunk included in the same single fill — no naturalistic green or brown, no shadow. Sits behind all foreground content via the page background-image stack.
components.css: background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: bottom center; background-size: auto 200px; background-attachment: fixed;

narrative.overview:
This system treats progress as something small and huggable to collect, never a stern readout to audit. Every screen is a single flat card resting on a solid indigo-navy ground, framed by a fixed treeline of stylized pine and blossom trees along the bottom edge — a whole world in lavender and pink, holding pill-shaped rows, a gradient count-pod, and a row of gem dots. This is the visual grammar of a friendly mobile dashboard, borrowed for a solo learner's vocabulary practice rather than a social feed: no leaderboard, no invented friends list, no fabricated social chrome, only what this app actually has (words learned, words due, a next action) rendered as something worth reaching for.

Two pastel accents, lavender and pink, carry the whole system against the navy ground — no third hue is introduced, not even for the trees themselves, which are flat lavender or pink silhouettes rather than naturalistic green-and-brown. Depth is deliberately absent: no drop shadows, no glow, no blur anywhere — every shape is a flat color fill separated from its neighbors by a border or plain color contrast, never a shadow. Type splits along a functional line: Baloo 2's chunky rounded geometry carries numerals, headings, and every button label; Quicksand's lighter rounded sans carries body copy and tracked labels; Caveat's handwritten script is reserved for the wordmark and small celebratory lines.
keyCharacteristics: Solid indigo-navy ground (#1e1836) — no gradient blooms, no glow — with a fixed treeline of flat-color pine/blossom tree silhouettes along the bottom edge and a faint grain texture.
Zero shadows anywhere in the system: cards, pods, gems, and buttons are all flat color fills bounded by a border, never lifted or glowing.
The treeline is monochrome-per-tree: each tree is solid lavender or solid pink, trunk included — never a naturalistic green/brown palette.
Rounded-[32px] cards, rounded-[28px] pill rows, and rounded-full buttons/pods/gems — no sharp or lightly-rounded corners anywhere in the system.
Baloo 2 for numerals, headings, and buttons; Quicksand for body and tracked labels; Caveat script reserved for the wordmark and celebratory microcopy only.
Buttons give feedback on press with a flat brightness dip (active:brightness-90) — never a shadow collapse or a translate.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Only lavender and pink carry saturated color in this system, including background scenery. A third hue — including green or brown for the treeline — is never introduced; alternate between the two instead.

rules.name: The Script-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Caveat sets at most one short line per screen — the wordmark or a single celebratory moment. It never sets a heading, a button, or a paragraph.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is never used in this system, for any purpose — not ambient lift, not glow, not a pressable ledge. Depth and separation come from color and border alone.

dos: Do keep every corner fully rounded or generously rounded (32px/28px/full) in UI chrome — the treeline's flat conifer triangles are the one exception.
Do reserve Caveat script for the wordmark and at most one celebratory line per screen.
Do alternate Lavender/Pink for repeated small identity marks (e.g. gems, grade buttons, treeline trees) rather than introducing a third color.
Do keep the navy ground's fixed treeline and grain texture on every screen; separate surfaces with color and border only.
donts: Don't use box-shadow anywhere in this system — no lift, no glow, no pressable ledge, and no gradient glow blooms on the page background.
Don't invent social features, avatars-as-people, or fake friend/leaderboard content this app doesn't have — borrow the reference world's pill-row grammar, never its social content.
Don't set a heading, button, or paragraph in Caveat — script is a rare accent, not a body or label face.
Don't introduce a third saturated color beyond Lavender and Pink, including in background scenery — a forest mood comes from silhouette shapes, never from adding green.
Don't use a sharp or lightly-rounded (2px/6px) corner anywhere in the UI chrome — that belonged to the discarded Instrument Panel system.
